title: Penne all'Arrabbiata
author: Claude
description: "Angry" penne: garlic and chili fried in olive oil, simmered with tomatoes. Pantry staples, twenty minutes.
steps: Put a large pot of salted water on to boil.
Gently fry the garlic and chili flakes in the olive oil until the garlic is pale gold, about 2 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and a pinch of salt; simmer for 10–12 minutes until thickened.
Cook the penne until al dente, drain and toss it in the sauce with a splash of the pasta water.
Serve with torn basil and parmesan if you like.
